comment: The local apps of the local AHP channel on a host with the root command x-air-ide/localAhpOpen. The test replaces ${scope} with a scope of its own, ${path} with the stable socket path of that scope, ${pid} with the pid of the test, and ${instances} with a directory of the test for the instance files. The steps localConnect, local and toLocal are those of local-ahp-channel.ndjson. A local app connects without access.
Before the holder gives the local apps, a client without access gets UNAUTHORIZED, and its stream ends.

params.message: Refused a connection of the pid ${pid}: UNAUTHORIZED

error.message: The connection carries no credential that the IDE knows.

data.message: The connection carries no credential that the IDE knows.
data.hint: Run air-ide from a session that the IDE started, with its AIR_CLI_ACCESS.

comment: localAhpApps gives the instance file, the hosts and the last focus. It writes the instance file <directory>/<pid>.json, which names the socket, and answers its path.
A client without access is now a local app. initialize lists its two methods: x-air-ij/hosts and x-air-ij/openDraft.

params.message: The conn 1 of the pid ${pid} opened

comment: A local app has no root subscription, so subscribe answers unknownMethod, and no question goes to the holder.

error.message: no request has the method subscribe

comment: A change of the rows gives a local app no root notice: the next frame of the client is the answer of hosts.
x-air-ij/hosts needs no consent. It answers the product, the build, the launch directories and the last focus of a window of the IDE.

params.message: conn 1 pid ${pid} subject app: method x-air-ij/hosts result ok

comment: A local app lists no session, so listSessions answers unknownMethod.

error.message: no request has the method listSessions

comment: x-air-ij/openDraft takes the string fields projectDirectory and prompt. The first draft reads the identity of the peer and asks the holder once with localAhpConsent. The grant answers {}, and the draft is one localAhpCall with the subject {kind: app}, the params {projectDirectory, prompt} and the host of projectDirectory: the deepest host that holds the directory. The holder opens a New Session tab with the prompt and the current choice of the picker, and answers {}. It sends nothing to the agent.

params.message: The conn 1 of the pid ${pid} got the consent of the IDE
conn 1 pid ${pid} subject app: method x-air-ij/openDraft result ok

comment: The prompt of a draft loses its control characters in air-ide: ESC goes, and a carriage return before a line feed becomes one line feed. So the holder gets a clean prompt.

params.message: conn 1 pid ${pid} subject app: method x-air-ij/openDraft result ok

comment: A directory that no host holds gets NO_PROJECT with the launch directories, and the holder gets no call.

error.message: No open project of the IDE holds the directory.

data.message: No open project of the IDE holds the directory.
data.hint: Open the project in the IDE, or ask another IDE: each instance file names the socket of one IDE.

params.message: conn 1 pid ${pid} subject app: method x-air-ij/openDraft result NO_PROJECT

comment: localAhpApps null deletes the instance file and ends each conn of a local app.

params.message: The conn 1 of the pid ${pid} ended
